notes.title: Update 1.7 is out now - NEW ADVENTURE & EVENT!
notes.content:
[img]http://s3.amazonaws.com/nkapi-user-documents-production/appdocs/16/assets/assets/BATTD_1_7_LumpySpace_CrossPromo_ULTRA.png[/img]
It's time for the final new content of the year for BATTD! Here's what's new:
[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Adventure: Promcoming - It’ll take more than a Bloon invasion to stop Lumpy Space Princess attending the promcoming dance! Help rid Lumpy Space of the Bloon menace in time for the dance. This adventure will unlock after completing the adventure Wizard Battle on any difficulty. The adventure is located in a new kingdom, Lumpy Space, which can be found in the forest south of Lemongrab.
[*] Added support for future events
[*] Added “Legendary” rarity. Items of this rarity can usually be obtained only through purchases, Legendary Wish Orbs, or the Martian Trader. The rarity of the following items has been increased to Legendary.
- Thundersword
- The Lover
- Silver Tipped Stakes
- Lady Rainicorn
- Vampire King
- Train Boss
- Clarence
- Holiday BMO
- Monkey Farmer
[*] We've also made a bunch of balance changes, a full list of which can be found [url=https://ninja.kiwi/battd_1.7]here[/url] or in the in-game patch notes!
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Dungeon Finn’s focused fire ability doing exponentially more damage the longer it lasts
[*] Fixed premium adventures not awarding allies if you’d already got them through other means
[*] Fixed conditional damage boosts not stacking correctly with other damage boosts
[*] Fixed Martian Game Quests tracking incorrectly
[*] Fixed drop and lock text sometimes not appearing.
[*] Fixed damage boosts not applying correctly to Sam
[*] Fixed Bloon Beacon chests appearing with incorrect graphics
[*] Fixed range circles not moving with their tower during Shuffle Martian Games
[*] Fixed Martian Transporter graphical issues and prevented it selecting itself for movement.
[*] Fixed Dark Temple Idol and Axe Bass displaying stats incorrectly
[*] Performance improvements
[/list]
As always, your feedback is welcome! We'd also like to take this opportunity to say a huge thanks for your support throughout 2019. You're all More Awesomer! Have a great holiday season and happy gaming :)

notes.title: Update 1.6 is out now - NEW ADVENTURE!
notes.content:
[img]https://static-api.nkstatic.com/appdocs/16/assets/assets/BATTD_1_6_Update_BSM2_ULTRA.png[/img]

It's update time again, Adventurers! Here's what's new:

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Adventure: From The Heart! Ricardio is causing trouble in the Ice Kingdom in a brand new, 3 map adventure. This adventure will unlock after completing the adventure Loch’d and Loaded on any difficulty
[*]Martian Games Milestone Rewards!Get extra crystals for reaching milestone rounds. Milestone rewards are given every 5 rounds after Round 10.You’ll earn rewards the first time you reach the milestone round regardless whether you captured the throne or not. Each milestone can be earned once per Games and reset with each new Martian Games.
[*]Performance improvements
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed incorrect player names appearing in Martian Games
[*]Fixed crash attempting to sign into an NK account
[*]Fixed an issue where players were not given the correct amount of crystals after returning to the game
[*]Improved wording when the Martian Games end during a capture attempt
[*]Fixed crash with the Fire Eyes power
[*]Fixed UI locking up when reaching round 100
[*]Fixed visual issue with Reconditioning Chamber’s electrified floors
[*]Fixed issue where Flame Princess would fire backwards
[*]Fixed incorrect placement areas in Reconditioning Chamber
[/list]

As always, let us know your feedback and happy gaming! :)

notes.title: Update 1.5 is out now - MARTIAN GAMES!
notes.content:
[img]https://static-api.nkstatic.com/appdocs/16/assets/assets/BATTD_1_5_Update_Lightbox.png[/img]
[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
    [*]New Game Mode: Martian Games!

       Access the Martian Games through Magic Man’s house, just below the 
       Haunted Swamp. You need to be Rank 10 or higher to enter the games. 
       Compete against other players to reach the highest round and claim the 
       Martian Throne. Hold the throne to generate Martian Crystals that can be 
       traded for rewards including premium characters and past event prizes. 
       Crazy new rules every few days that will require you to think up exciting  
       new strategies.

    [*]25 brand new items, including 10 exclusive Martian items only available through the Martian Games. The other 15 will appear in wish orbs as normal.
    [*]New Quests and Achievements related to the Martian Games
[/list]
[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Tuxedo Jake
        -Base cost reduced from $1100 to $600
        -Royalties cost reduced from $3800 to $500
        -Musician cost reduced from $2300 to $1150 
        -Musician drops 6 cash bundles instead of 5
        -Superstar now requires both Musician and Royalties upgrades
        -Superstar now drops 6 mega bundles of $250 each

    [*]Commander Cassie
        -Bloontonium Tips now gives +1 damage in addition to its other effects
        -Mounted Mauler damage increased from 60 to 70

    [*]Juggernaut Max
        -Base Range increased from 40 to 45
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed crash when selling Marceline in her bat form
    [*]Fixed Dirt Beer Guy’s thorns not being able to pop camo
    [*]Fixed Dirt Beer Guy text error
    [*]Fixed Captain Cassie’s MOAB takedown not working on DDTs
    [*]Fixed Soul Stone trinket not working with other cost reduction effects
    [*]Fixed Lumpy Space Princess not being able to stun bloons
    [*]Fixed Commander Cassie’s darts not taking boosts from damage items
    [*]Fixed C4 Charlie’s MOAB Assassin ability being able to hit multiple MOABs per shot
    [*]Fixed Candy Dive Suit not working correctly on Wizard Royale map
[/list]

Good luck, Adventurers, and happy gaming! :D

notes.title: BATTD Update 1.4.1 is live now - BALANCE OVERHAUL!
notes.content:
[img]https://static-api.nkstatic.com/appdocs/16/assets/assets/BalanceChange_02.png[/img]

Welcome, Adventurers! We've been hard at work testing all the characters and items in Ooo and we've come up with a few changes that we think will make the game more fun for everyone. Many characters who were weaker than they should have been have been made stronger, while others who were a little too powerful have been scaled back. 

A full list of what has changed can be found here: https://ninja.kiwi/battd141patchnotes

As always, your feedback is welcome and happy gaming!

notes.title: BATTD Update 1.4 is live now - NEW ADVENTURE!
notes.content:
[img]https://static-api.nkstatic.com/appdocs/16/assets/assets/BATTD_1_4_Update_NK-Lightbox.png[/img]
Math! It's update time again and we're bringing you a new adventure!

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Attention Adventurers! Lemongrab is up to his old tricks and is using the Bloon invasion as a distraction while he invades the Candy Kingdom. Put a stop to his plans in a brand new, 4 map adventure! You can find this new challenge in the Candy Kingdom after completing the Lemongrabbed adventure.
    [*]We've also added a brand new premium ally, the Monkey Farmer! Place him in a game to automatically collect any dropped loot.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed Wolf Pack and Fire Wolves powers not working correctly on multi path maps.
    [*]Fixed Warrior Bubblegum’s Candy Copters not attacking bloons correctly
    [*]Fixed unclear text regarding Cosmic Essence
    [*]Fixed Ad rerolling not working correctly
    [*]Fixed Sam’s Lightning attack audio issue
    [*]Fixed Tuxedo Jake’s range boost not applying correctly
    [*]Fixed Ball Blam Burglerber and Cryojet affecting DDTs incorrectly
    [*]Fixed Jake Suit conflicting with some items
    [*]Fixed lock when accepting save conflicts
    [*]Fixed UI issues in Choose Goose’s store
[/list]

As always, let us know your feedback in the comments below and happy gaming!

notes.title: BATTD Update 1.3.3 is live now - Patch notes!
notes.content:
There are quite a few changes in this patch, so let's take a look!

[h1]General Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added option to quickly shard a wish orb without opening it. Shard values are equal to an item of the same rarity as the wish orb. This option appears to players who are rank 10 or above.
[*] Sharding the first item from a wish orb will now automatically dismiss the other two items.
[/list]
[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] It is no longer possible to stack bloon status effects (you cannot freeze a bloon that was already frozen etc.)
[*] Vampire Hunter Marceline can now aim and shoot through most objects
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Implemented a number of in-game performance improvements
[*] Fixed hotkey not collecting BMO’s cash (Targeting hotkey - desktop only)
[*] Fixed crash using Cassie’s MOAB takedown ability
[*] Fixed missing ally names
[*] Fixed visual issue in Pep But’s Lab
[*] Fixed seasonal items appearing in Choose Goose’s store out of season
[*] Fixed crash with Crystal Copy Finn appearing out of range of the path
[*] Fixed Wolf Pack power not working on Enchiridion Map
[*] Fixed wish orbs not opening after crafting unless on the world screen
[*] Fixed lack of feedback when trying to remove obstacles without enough cash
[*] Fixed minor UI issues
[*] Fixed Frozen Throwing Knives appearing out of Supermonkey’s laser whips
[*] Fixed Magic Coin Purse not working when equipped to Marceline
[*] Fixed Gemma the Gemstone and Carl the Gem not applying their damage boost
[*] Minor text fixes
[*] Fixed Frozen Throwing Knives not inheriting damage type from equipped tower.
[*] Fixed graphical issue on Supermonkey’s laser eye projectile
[*] Fixed graphical effect on Billy’s Giant Gem power
[*] Fixed incorrect damage amount from Abracadaniel’s Wand
[*] Fixed UI issue with game ending while placing a tower
[*] Fixed Blessed Dart effect not working when equipped to Commander Cassie
[*] Fixed summoned towers impacting quests
[/list]

As always, your feedback is welcome :D
